what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Eswatini in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 472 asylum seekers from Eswatini, and Ireland hosted 77.8% of them.
After Ireland, the largest hosts are the Netherlands, Germany and Canada.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Eswatini, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2001 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 543, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
